## History

Chester Sloane is a student whose grandmother left him money to attend college on the strict condition that he become a minister. During a difficult day in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's classroom, he accidentally causes fireworks to explode. His actions contribute to a chaotic day at school that ends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disciplining another student.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), +22 more_
